# ZeeSiemens

**Author:** Mr.Zee<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD)

ZeeSiemens removes the SP Lock operator lock and the PhoneCode from Siemens C35, M35, and S35 regardless of firmware version.
The program connects to a powered-on phone via a service cable and displays its Phone ID.

## Versions

- **G3** — [zeesiemens-g3.zip](https://git.siepatch.dev/siepatch/soft/media/branch/main/catalog/service/zeesiemens/files/zeesiemens-g3.zip)<br/>Windows 32-bit · 20.3 KiB
